Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — An article on the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere, and large windows offer panoramic views of the city skyline. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make each visit feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction to your personal site, and I like that it keeps things simple and personal. A couple of suggestions if you'd like to make it more engaging: adding a bit more about your interests, work, or projects would give visitors a better sense of who you are, and including some links or photos could make the page feel more lively. Overall, it's a solid starting point — keep it up!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I love that you share your passion for hiking — it's a great topic and gives the blog a personal, authentic feel. A few ideas to make it even better: adding photos or descriptions from your hikes, sharing specific trail recommendations or maps, and posting about recent adventures would help readers connect with your experiences. Overall, it's a charming blog with a clear personal touch — I'd love to read more about your hiking trips!
